goal: An ecological, original-GPS multi-source analysis of solar-relative animal movement directions under varying actual-hour modelled wind, radiation and thermal conditions. Expand beyond the two postselected multispecies ecology archives; retain original full source denominator and ecological failure statuses.

frame.selection: ALL 24 archives fixed by original Movebank GPS header and source-only metadata, NOT by previously observed sunward-effect sign, weather values or treatment outcome. Preserve unsupported species and all weather source HOLDs.
frame.source_study_unit: Original public Movebank study-ID within archived package; two subregion-years or species from the same study are NOT independent field populations. Raw original source animal names never exported.

GPS.provider: Movebank provider ORIGINAL bitstream, exact frozen UUID/checksum/bytes. No substitutes if original MD5 no longer matches.
GPS.method: Reuse scripts/global_solar_azimuth_12_new_original_events_v1.py strict original taxon-time parser and scripts/solar_azimuth_macro_v0.py fixed astronomical direction/cadence thresholds. Select closest original source UTC fix to the start of each UTC hour using timestamp only, then 0.5–2h, >=100m observed step, <=60km/h and sun geometric elevation at both endpoints and midpoint >=10 degrees.
GPS.preweather_replay: For EACH native source taxon, reproduce first v2 original GPS source taxon status, animal count and sunward/clock-adjusted original group mean exactly with tolerance <=1e-12 before any ERA5 call. If source integrity or baseline replay fails, mark SOURCE_HOLD and read no weather.
GPS.observed_gridyear: floor original GPS-step midpoint WGS84 latitude to integer degree, circular longitude floor to degree, and midpoint UTC year. Coordinates never leave runner.
GPS.source_siteyear_selection: For each original source native taxon separately rank original daylight directional GPS grid-years by the number of distinct tagged original source animals, then count of accepted daylight displacement intervals, then lexicographically ascending grid/year. Retain top TWO grid-years with >=3 animals, >=30 accepted original GPS intervals and >=3 solar dates, only years 1940–2025 inclusive. No replacement if a chosen cell-year fails original weather access. This support-only selection is after previous solar results so it is explicitly exploratory, not a newly independent random global sample.

weather.model: ERA5 hourly historical archive via public Open-Meteo; no Best Match, no multi-model interpolation
weather.grid: 1-degree WGS84 cell center (floor midpoint source GPS lat+0.5, floor midpoint source GPS lon+0.5), exactly ONE full original observation UTC calendar year per selected original cell-year.
weather.join: Original GPS step midpoint time rounded DOWN to beginning of UTC hour; no time interpolation and no source event substitution.
weather.provenance: Source provider raw hourly JSON SHA-256 and anonymous source-year sample coverage (not exact grid or animal event time) preserved; raw climate JSON bodies are not archived, so later refetch may drift. No new weather effects used to select study/source/year.
weather.exposure_limit: Wind at 100m is modelled meteorology not actual altitude experienced by flying bird; shortwave is gridded preceding-hour radiation not individual incident solar energy; ambient 2m modelled temperature not body temperature.

response.primary_description: For each admitted taxon × source-grid-year: equal original animals, mean cos(GPS travel bearing − sun azimuth), mean cos(GPS travel bearing − 100m wind flow TO), mean cos(100m wind flow TO − sun azimuth), and mean ERA5 windspeed/shortwave/2m temperature, calculated on EXACT same daytime moving GPS intervals.
response.source_environmental_support: At least 5 different source tagged animals each with >=10 weather-complete GPS intervals spanning >=3 solar dates in this selected grid-year. >=90% original accepted GPS steps joined to ERA5 data, and at least 5 animals retained. Otherwise environmental result unavailable, not ecological zero.
response.month_solar_clock_stratification: For association estimates only, within each tagged individual, within UTC calendar month × original apparent solar 4-hour clock bin, require >=8 weather-joined GPS intervals over >=3 solar dates, and at least TWO supported blocks per animal. The selected coarse GPS grid-year is always constant within an analyzed source-context.

association_predictors.windspeed: ERA5 100m wind speed, slope per 1 m/s
association_predictors.shortwave: ERA5 gridded shortwave, slope per +100 W/m²

response.regression: Within individual and month×solar-hour blocks, center predictor and cos(GPS bearing − solar azimuth); sum within-block covariance over sum within-block predictor squared deviations, with >=2 varying blocks and >=20 original matched steps per animal. These are FOUR separately estimated univariate associations, NOT jointly adjusted or causal effects.
response.uncertainty: 1000 original tagged-individual cluster bootstrap draws, deterministic seed 20261025. Source-group-only descriptive percentile intervals, NO per-step iid p values and NO source independence implied.
response.reporting: All 24 source archives and original native taxon combinations, all selected/failing site-years, original selected weather support, weather receipt hashes; publish NO GPS precise coordinates, cell IDs, individual IDs, exact timestamps, request URLs or animal-level coefficients.

hypothesis: Sun-relative travel heading is environmentally context dependent rather than one universal sunward-or-antisunward response. Wind-flow geometry and wind/shortwave/temperature conditions may contribute to its variation across populations but the observational test cannot identify cause, or prove animals sense/avoid the Sun.
inferential_limit: Even among public independent field study-ID labels, the measured source-gridyear is a convenience population, not a globally area-weighted biome sample. Coarse climate, solar geometry, migration, selected fix cadence, biological guild, time and seasonal history remain confounded. Compare source block means; never count individual GPS fixes, animals within a source or multiple years/grids in one original study as independent ecosystems.
